title: Razer AI Creator Program
author: Razer-Plood
selftext:
**Hey everyone!** 

**I’m from the Razer Software Team!** We’re launching the **Razer Creator Alpha**, and we’re looking for devs and creators to help us test some new AI-powered game development tools. If you want to experiment and help build something unique, sign up and join the program. 

Lots of stuff is still under embargo so I can’t give too many details, but happy to answer, or pass any questions you have. 

Also, as a bonus we’ll be giving out some gear to some of our early adopters! Sign up here: [RAZER AI CREATOR Alpha - Razer AI](https://apc01.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.razer.ai%2Fcreator-alpha%2F&data=05%7C02%7CArvel.Reeves%40razer.com%7C23928a2c67e643517dea08de2bba3947%7Cfdadce6e7f5e49db8f226a87331a9135%7C0%7C0%7C638996276047764458%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=ZKUrGD%2FMAhtCJQAXzICyq2ItoGIfCVGVIBh2LbLnV9g%3D&reserved=0)
